about: Mesh texts and what they parse to, run by crates/riddle-mesh/tests/grammar.rs against the Rust parser and by apps/desktop/src/lib/mocks/dsl.grammar.test.ts against the browser mock, so the two cannot drift. `mesh` and each of `outputs` list only the fields a case is about; `error` is a substring both parsers' messages must contain.

cases.name: header lines
cases.text:
Mesh: Daily reminders v3
Priority: 15
Autonomy: Suggest
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Spoil

cases.name: every disposition
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Find: Follow Up
ELSE IF has_attachments → Filed
ELSE IF gmail_important → Spoil
ELSE IF reply_to_mismatch → Contamination
ELSE → Escalate

cases.name: strata and notify combine with a disposition
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Find: Pay + Stratum: Finance, Bills + Notify

cases.name: replaces and expires on a Find
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF subject CONTAINS "Time to write" → Find: Do + Replaces + Expires: 18h
ELSE IF mailing_list → Find: Know + Expires: 2 days
ELSE IF has_attachments → Find: Review + Expires: 36 hours

cases.name: a WHEN block and its ELSE
cases.text:
ROUTES
WHEN sender_domain = github.com
    IF sender_name CONTAINS "dependabot" → Spoil
    ELSE → Filed
END

cases.name: replaces on Spoil and Filed, where only the newest matters
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Spoil + Replaces
ELSE IF has_attachments → Filed + Stratum: Receipts + Replaces

cases.name: Replaces needs a Find, Spoil or Filed
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Contamination + Replaces
cases.error: Replaces needs a Find, Spoil or Filed

cases.name: Expires needs a Find
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Filed + Expires: 2d
cases.error: Expires closes Finds, so it needs a Find

cases.name: a dated Find waits for its days and expires after them
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF has_dates → Find: Attend + Expires: After its dates

cases.name: expires at the end of the day or the next morning, where the user is
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Find: Do + Replaces + Expires: end of day
ELSE IF has_attachments → Find: Do + Expires: Next  Morning

cases.name: Expires is not a vague time
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Find: Do + Expires: later
cases.error: Expires needs minutes, hours, days, end of day, next morning or after its dates

cases.name: Expires without a value
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Find: Do + Expires
cases.error: Expires needs minutes, hours, days, end of day, next morning or after its dates

cases.name: Expires of zero
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Find: Do + Expires: 0h
cases.error: Expires is between 1 hour and 90 days

cases.name: Expires past ninety days
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Find: Do + Expires: 91d
cases.error: Expires is between 1 hour and 90 days

cases.name: a fraction of a day
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Find: Do + Expires: 1.5d
cases.error: Expires needs minutes, hours, days, end of day, next morning or after its dates

cases.name: Find without a type
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Find

cases.name: an unknown Find type
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Find: Ponder

cases.name: an unknown output
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Archive

cases.name: a named list of another text fact
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF sender_name IN list:github_bots → Filed

cases.name: a named list
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF sender_domain IN list:keep_promotions → Filed
ELSE IF sender IN list:Banks → Find: Pay

cases.name: importance and a minute expiry
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF subject CONTAINS "code" → Find: Know + Notify + Expires: 15m + Importance: Critical
ELSE IF mailing_list → Spoil + Importance: low

cases.name: an unknown importance
cases.text:
ROUTES
IF mailing_list → Spoil + Importance: urgent
cases.error: unknown Importance urgent; use Low, Normal, High or Critical
